entries.name: VISR
entries.status_notes: Plays in a window on visionOS 2 or later. Enter VR (stereo around you, or the 3D theater screen) needs visionOS 26 or later, and PlayStation VR2 Sense aiming needs visionOS 27, per the install guide.
entries.description: Native Metal port of Halo: Combat Evolved for Apple Vision Pro and other Apple devices. Head-tracked stereo, foveated rendering, a 3D theater screen and PlayStation VR2 Sense controller aiming. Bring your own disc image of the original Xbox release.

screenshots.alt: VISR: the app icon, a helmet with a gold visor, beside the VISR wordmark on a dark teal grid

credits.name: Klepton

entries.status_notes: Own code (launcher, renderer) is MIT; the reVC engine itself has no license and is published as-is. Requires the player's own classic PC copy of Vice City (not the Definitive Edition). Tested on Apple Vision Pro M2 and M5.
entries.description: Native Vision Pro port of reVC, the reverse-engineered GTA Vice City engine: stereo rendering in a full immersive space, head tracking, foveated rendering, game-controller input, and a launcher for settings, save games and the game data. Bring your own classic PC copy.

entries.name: V
entries.status_notes: Windowed play is stable per the developer. Experimental third-person immersion has remaining image-quality, depth-edge, flicker and performance bugs.
entries.description: Native Apple-platform GTA V port built on Muguet, with local ahead-of-time compiled game code, a game window and experimental head-tracked third-person immersion.

entries.name: AVPcraft
entries.status_notes: Windowed play needs further testing; immersive mode has remaining bugs. The complete build has not yet been repeated from a clean public checkout. See the install guide for known limits.
entries.description: Minecraft: Java Edition 26.2 compiled ahead of time for Vision Pro, with an AVPcraft launcher, windowed play, Vivecraft immersion and PSVR2 Sense input.

credits.role: Executable translation, native runtime, Metal renderer and visionOS port

entries.status_notes: Windowed play is stable per the developer. Immersive mode has remaining bugs; tracked input targets on-foot campaign play. Vehicles and turrets use conventional controls.
